channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Caitlin Clark | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Caitlin Clark from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sophie Cunningham on Caitlin Clark
item.description:
Sophie Cunningham:

“It's insane. People should just be happy that USA went in there and got it done and they got the gold. I'm biased probably becauseI love (Caitlin Clark) and she's my teammate, but I definitely think that she should have been starting. But again, I'm not the coach, I don't know what they have going on. We got the dub, that's all that matters, we got the gold, now they're back. You're never going to win with this crowd, I'm telling you. You're going to get hated, you're going to get loved on, so that's why you just kind of do what you want around here.”

Sophie Cunningham on Caitlin Clark, Sep 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Caitlin Clark
item.description:
“But I refused to cheer for Caitlin until she got out of college because I'm not cheering for Iowa.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Caitlin Clark, Jun 13, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Etan Thomas on Caitlin Clark, Paige Bueckers
item.description:
However, former NBA veteran Etan Thomas, the No. 12 pick in the 2000 draft, contrasts how white Americans view the two based on their stark differences in speaking out against racial injustice.

“Perhaps it’s because, unlike Clark, Bueckers has always been outspoken about issues off the court,”

Etan Thomas on Caitlin Clark, Paige Bueckers, Mar 28, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Adam Silver on Caitlin Clark
item.description:
“They all did their jobs the way they were instructed to… [Caitlin Clark] was already Rookie of the Month in the WNBA…I’m sure there’ll be lots of opportunities for her to represent our country.”

Adam Silver on Caitlin Clark, Jun 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Caitlin Clark
item.description:
“I think it's kind of a right of passage for young players, whether it's the WNBA or the NBA. The other players are going to test you. Actually, Caitlin reminds me a lot of Steph Curry. A lot of people may not remember this, but in Steph's first couple of years, he was not a superstar. He was not who he is now. He had to get stronger, he had to understand people were coming after him. That's what is happening with Caitlin right now,”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Caitlin Clark, Jun 12, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Draymond Green on Caitlin Clark
item.description:
“Love what you did. I don’t love how you went to the press conference and wouldn’t answer a question about [Caitlin Clark]… You did what you did. Stand on it.”

Draymond Green on Caitlin Clark, Jun 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Under Armour on Stephen Curry, Caitlin Clark
item.description:
“He has Curry Brand with Under Armour. He was involved with that pitch. Him and Caitlin Clark, I think, are beginning to build a relationship, but she’s not signing there. And she will soon be official with Nike.”

Under Armour on Stephen Curry, Caitlin Clark, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Awful Announcing.
